caveat: This measures what csoai.org/api/tools SERVES, not what exists in PyPI or GitHub. There may be more packages published than the catalogue exposes — that is itself the finding: the catalogue is the discoverable surface and it exposes 7.
G3_consequence: Under the counter-canon's own law a number needs an evidence file. Here the evidence file is live and contradicts the published figures. The honest public statement is '7 tools across 3 servers, served at csoai.org/api/tools' — verifiable in one curl by anyone.
